name: implement-handoff
description: Single forked worker implementation with explicit acceptance evidence.

chain.label: Single writer
chain.task:
Implement the approved request as the sole writer. Keep scope narrow, follow existing project patterns, and escalate unapproved product, architecture, or scope decisions instead of guessing.

Approved request:
{task}

Return a handoff with changed files, what was implemented, what was left undone, commands run with exit codes, validation evidence, surprises or new risks, and decisions needing parent approval.

criteria: Implement the approved request without widening scope.
Return evidence for changed files, validation, residual risks, and open decisions.
